dct_description_sm: This dataset contains raw and processed AZFP (echosounder) and CATS tag data, corresponding to a related publication on the foraging behaviour of a humpback whale feeding on walleye pollock in the Juan de Fuca Strait, Canada.
dct_title_s: Replication Data for: Integrating technologies provides insights into the foraging behaviour of a humpback whale feeding on walleye pollock in Juan de Fuca Strait, Canada
